fields.Name: T151 - New Prediction Copilot Panel
fields.Description: Exercises the docked Model Dev Agent co-pilot embed (mj-conversation-chat-area inside the Predictions resource) and its open/close chrome — distinct from the main chat overlay and from the Studio copilot.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Predictive Studio app (open via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, scroll if needed), on the 'Predictions' door, click the '+ New prediction' button (or the 'Build your first prediction' button in the empty state). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Success is a docked co-pilot chat panel sliding in on the right, titled 'New prediction' with a Model Development Agent conversation area and a message composer. You do NOT need to send a message — seeing the docked agent chat panel render is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking '+ New prediction' opens a docked chat panel titled 'New prediction' on the right side
The panel contains a conversation/message input area for the Model Development Agent
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
